guard: an inline persona is validated and bounded like a file, written only after the grant, launched from its own snapshot, and removed with its seat; a saved copy keeps the checked grant
why: N1 opens the closed record. N2 lets another launch read a seat's snapshot. N3 lets a clash reach
allocation, so it refuses after the spawn started. N4 writes the catalog copy before the grant, so
a refused user-auth grant still leaves a reusable persona behind. N5 saves the record's omissions,
so a later spawner's own default fills the copy. N6 restarts a seat from a changed snapshot.
N7, N8 and N9 each drop one removal: the live slot free (the only one an open mesh has), the
static retirement terminal (the one a boot sweep reaches), and the spawn's own rollback (the only
one an open mesh's failed launch has). N10 lets a resume inventory point a seat at another file.
N11 keys the snapshot by the uid the spawn allocated, which a hosted enrollment replaces.
N12 lets a restart trust a recorded path that names another file with that file's digest.
N13 lets a spawn whose snapshot write found a file at its path delete that file at the terminal.

mutations.name: N1 accept an unknown key in the record
mutations.find: if (extra.length) throw new Error(`persona: unknown key ${extra[0]}; it takes ${INLINE_PERSONA_KEYS.join(", ")}`);
mutations.expectRed: an unknown key in the persona is refused by name

mutations.name: N2 let a spawn name a snapshot as its persona file
mutations.expectRed: a config path at a live snapshot is refused

mutations.name: N3 drop the clash check before allocation
mutations.expectRed: a save under a name the catalog holds is refused, naming both exits

mutations.name: N4 save the catalog copy before the grant
mutations.find: if (boundRefusal) return { ok: false, error: boundRefusal };
mutations.replace:
if (boundRefusal) return { ok: false, error: boundRefusal };
    if (inline?.save) saveAgentFile(agentFilePath(this.workspaceRoot, ref), { name: ref, subscribe: [] }, { createOnly: true });
mutations.expectRed: a refused user-auth grant leaves no catalog file

mutations.name: N5 save the record's omissions instead of the checked grant
mutations.replace:
subscribe: def?.subscribe ?? [],
          allowSubscribe: def?.allowSubscribe,
          allowPublish: def?.allowPublish,
mutations.expectRed: a later narrower spawner is refused the channels the saved copy names

mutations.name: N6 restart an inline seat without checking its snapshot
mutations.replace: const changed = undefined as string | undefined;
mutations.expectRed: a changed snapshot retires a supervised inline seat instead of restarting it

mutations.name: N7 keep the snapshot when the live slot frees
mutations.expectRed: an open-mesh inline seat's snapshot goes when its seat exits

mutations.name: N8 keep the snapshot at the static retirement terminal
mutations.expectRed: the static retirement terminal removes a snapshot by its lifecycle uid

mutations.name: N9 keep the snapshot when the spawn rolls back
mutations.expectRed: an open-mesh spawn that fails after its snapshot removes it

mutations.name: N10 accept a resume entry whose snapshot is another path
mutations.expectRed: a resume entry whose inline snapshot is not its lifecycle's path is refused

mutations.name: N11 key the snapshot by the allocated uid instead of the granted one
mutations.expectRed: a user-auth snapshot is keyed by the uid the grant settled on

mutations.name: N12 check the recorded snapshot path instead of the lifecycle's own
mutations.expectRed: a restart refuses a recorded snapshot path that is not the lifecycle's own

mutations.name: N13 let the rollback's terminal remove the uid's path
mutations.expectRed: and it leaves the file the write refused
